title_ar: فضيلة الشيخ يقوم بزيارات تعزية لأسر علماء وأعيان في الداخل
title_en: His Eminence the Sheikh Makes Condolence Visits to the Families of Scholars and Notables in the Interior
body_ar:
قدم فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن ولد الددو يومي الأحد والاثنين 23-24 محرم 1433 الموافق 18-19/12/2011 واجب العزاء لعدد من الأسر في الداخل إثر وفاة عدة علماء أجلاء وأعيان محليين نهاية الأسبوع الماضي.

وقد زار فضيلته على وجه الخصوص أسرة أهل الشيخ سيديا في بتلميت لتعزيتها في وفاة المغفور له الخليفة العام لأسرة أهل الشيخ سيديا فضيلة الشيخ عبد الرحمن بن محمد بن سيد المختار بن الشيخ سيديا.

كما زار فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن ولد الددو أيضا أسرة أهل الشيخ القاضي بقرية بوطلحايه، وقدم تعازيه في وفاة المرحوم الخليفة العام لأهل الشيخ القاضي فضيلة الشيخ المصطفى بن الشيخ القاضي.

وأدى فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن ولد الددو زيارة أخرى لأسرة أهل ابات لتعزيتها في وفاة العالم الرباني العلامة محمد ابات ولد محمد ولد أحمد ول ابات شيخ محظرة أم النوار في لعصابه.

وقام فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن ولد الددو بزيارة أيضا لأسرة أهل أحمد زيدان في كامور لتعزيتها في وفاة فضيلة الشيخ محمد يحي ولد باب ولد أحمد زيدان رحمه الله تعالى.

وقد التقى فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن ولد الددو خلال رحلته هذه أعيان بلديتي كامور والغايره، وقدم على هامش تلك اللقاءات بعض التوجيهات والنصائح للتجمعات النسوية في المنطقتين بالتعاون مع الجمعية النسوية.

وقد رافق الشيخ في هذه الرحلة عدد من المشايخ منهم على وجه الخصوص: عبد الرحمن الداخل، وسيدي مولود ولد جاكير، وامادي ولد سيد المختار، ومحمد الحسن ولد امود، وشيخنا ولد سيدي الحاج.
body_en:
On Sunday and Monday, 23–24 Muharram 1433, corresponding to 18–19/12/2011, His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan Ould al-Dedew paid the duty of condolence to a number of families in the interior, following the deaths of several eminent scholars and local notables at the end of last week.

His Eminence visited in particular the family of Ahl al-Shaykh Sidiya in Boutilimit, to offer its members condolences on the death of the late general khalifah of the family of Ahl al-Shaykh Sidiya, His Eminence Sheikh ʿAbd al-Rahman ibn Muhammad ibn Sid al-Mukhtar ibn al-Shaykh Sidiya.

His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan Ould al-Dedew also visited the family of Ahl al-Shaykh al-Qadi in the village of Boutalhaya, and offered his condolences on the death of the late general khalifah of Ahl al-Shaykh al-Qadi, His Eminence Sheikh al-Mustafa ibn al-Shaykh al-Qadi.

His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan Ould al-Dedew made a further visit to the family of Ahl Abat, to offer its members condolences on the death of the godly scholar, the learned Muhammad Abat Ould Muhammad Ould Ahmad Wal Abat, sheikh of the maḥẓarah of Umm al-Nuwar in Assaba.

His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan Ould al-Dedew also made a visit to the family of Ahl Ahmad Zaydan in Kamour, to offer its members condolences on the death of His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad Yahya Ould Bab Ould Ahmad Zaydan, may God Almighty have mercy on him.

During this journey His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan Ould al-Dedew met the notables of the communes of Kamour and al-Ghayrah, and on the margins of those meetings gave some directions and counsel to the women's gatherings in the two areas, in cooperation with the women's association.

A number of sheikhs accompanied the Sheikh on this journey, among them in particular: ʿAbd al-Rahman al-Dakhil; Sidi Mawlud Ould Jakir; Amadi Ould Sid al-Mukhtar; Muhammad al-Hasan Ould Amud; and Shaykhna Ould Sidi al-Hajj.

flags.arabic: أسرة أهل الشيخ سيديا في بتلميت / أهل الشيخ القاضي بقرية بوطلحايه / أهل ابات … في لعصابه / أهل أحمد زيدان في كامور / بلديتي كامور والغايره
flags.context: the families and places named throughout the record
options: romanise by the commonest Mauritanian Latin-script forms, as done here
transliterate the Arabic strictly with diacritics
flags.note: Mauritanian place and family names have established Latin-script forms that do not follow from the Arabic: بتلميت is Boutilimit, لعصابه is the wilaya of Assaba, كامور is Kamour. Others have no settled form at all — بوطلحايه and الغايره are rendered here as Boutalhaya and al-Ghayrah on the strength of the Arabic alone. The record is almost entirely proper names, so this is the main translation decision in it and a reviewer with local knowledge should go through the list.

flags.arabic: الخليفة العام لأسرة أهل الشيخ سيديا
flags.context: the office held by the two men whose deaths occasioned the visits
flags.note: خليفة عام here is the head of a Mauritanian scholarly house, the successor to its founding sheikh, not a caliph and not an administrative deputy. 'Caliph' would be badly misleading in English; 'general khalifah' keeps the title untranslated but visible as a title; option 2 explains it at the cost of the word. Not in the glossary, and it recurs wherever a Mauritanian scholarly family is reported on.

flags.arabic: محمد ابات ولد محمد ولد أحمد ول ابات
flags.context: the name of the sheikh of the maḥẓarah of Umm al-Nuwar
options: reproduce the sequence exactly as given, including ول
flags.note: The third link of the name is written ول rather than ولد, which is either a dialect spelling or a typing error in the CMS. It is reproduced exactly as given in body_ar and rendered 'Wal' in the English so that the inconsistency inside a single name remains visible. Style guide section 11 forbids silent repair.

flags.arabic: وقدم … بعض التوجيهات والنصائح للتجمعات النسوية في المنطقتين
flags.note: توجيهات and نصائح are not ruling words and must not be allowed to sound like them. Option 3 in particular would make 'recommendations' out of نصائح, and 'recommended' is the fixed rendering of mandūb in the five-rulings table; a reader would be entitled to think a ruling had been given. Nothing of what was said survives in the record.

translator_notes: A short news report of condolence visits. No ruling is stated anywhere in it and the five-rulings mapping of style guide section 3 is not engaged. واجب in the first sentence is part of the idiom أدى واجب العزاء, 'paid the duty of condolence', and is a social duty in ordinary Arabic, not the technical wājib of the table.
The CMS timestamp is a bulk-upload date and is not evidence of when the report was written. The body dates the visits to 18–19 December 2011, and the hijri and Gregorian dates agree with each other.
المغفور له and المرحوم are the standard Arabic formulae for the recently dead; both are rendered 'the late', which flattens a small difference between them that English has no means of carrying.
شيخنا ولد سيدي الحاج here and شيخنا ولد سيد الحاج in record 756 of this span appear to be the same person, spelled differently in the two records. Neither has been altered.
محظرة أم النوار is the same institution type as in records 756, 768 and 773 in this span, and takes whatever fixed rendering the corpus settles on for محظرة.
